target: 03 Requirements and specifications/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v7/Recovery Workbench FSD P3 Case and workflow v5.md

fixes.old: The module reads ACE through the `recovery.v_ace_*` views only. A direct read of a `public` table
fixes.new: The module reads ACE through the rwb-source-data contract only (Architecture v5, slide 45; ADR-010), using the `recovery.v_ace_*` views listed below. A direct read of a `public` table

fixes.old: **Links.** Each link is a `varchar(255)` business key with no foreign key, because ACE deletes on `account` cascade. Referential integrity is checked by the read model and by REC-05, not by the database.
fixes.new: **Ledger.** The interaction ledger is owned by `rwb-source-data` (DP-18). This module writes ledger entries only through the rwb-source-data ledger contract, with one writer per ledger. This document defines no interaction table and no ledger intake rule table.

fixes.old: **Case list.** SCR-02 and every queue view read the case, queue and owner from Workbench tables and the account columns (account number, days past due, balance, data as of) from `v_ace_account` by `case_list_row.account_key`. Reconciliation of the case list to `v_ace_account` is `reconciliation_result` (JOB-04); a business key with no ACE row is listed by REC-05.
fixes.new: **Screen states (SCR-46).** SCR-46 has empty, loading, error and no-access states. Their content: Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-ITG-E1059-ITG-10).

disposition.note: A1.5 now reads ACE through the rwb-source-data contract; business-key link rules in A1.5 unchanged.
SCR-46 empty, loading, error and no-access states added; screen content not in sources, so recorded as Not specified.
No interaction or ledger intake table is defined here; added ledger ownership by rwb-source-data with one writer per ledger.
